state.hypothesis_to_verify: Kelmora's application satisfies every requirement for a blue archive pass under the current pass policy.

curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: An application satisfies the blue archive pass requirements if and only if it includes a signed request, a sponsor code, and a completed orientation record. There are no other requirements.
The submitted application contains a signed request, sponsor code SC-48, and an orientation record marked completed.

rationale: The policy gives an exhaustive three-part test, and the inspection establishes all three parts for the named application.
discriminating_fact: Every required item is affirmatively documented.

state.hypothesis_to_verify: Under the operative rules, Tavulen's kiosk is ready to open with its inspection certificate and operator roster, even though it has neither a welcome banner nor a guest ledger.

curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: A kiosk is ready to open when it has a current inspection certificate and a filed operator roster. These are the only prerequisites. A welcome banner is optional. A guest ledger is not required.
The certificate is current and the operator roster is filed. No welcome banner or guest ledger is present.

rationale: Both required prerequisites are met; the policy explicitly removes the two absent items from the prerequisites.
discriminating_fact: The missing banner is optional and the missing ledger is expressly not required.

state.hypothesis_to_verify: All three Sorevik research-group lockers were sealed during the 14:00 inspection on Day 12.

curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: The group's complete locker inventory is R1, R2, and R3. At 14:00 each of R1, R2, and R3 had an intact seal.
Visitor lockers V1 and V2 were unsealed. These lockers are assigned only to the visitor group.
Research locker R2 was unsealed at this inspection.

rationale: The complete inventory and inspection establish the claim at its specified group and time. The unsealed lockers belong to another group or another day.
discriminating_fact: The opposing observations do not share both the claimed group and the claimed time.

state.hypothesis_to_verify: At 10:00 on Day 21, Bristava's parcel qualifies for the priority lane.

curated_evidence_sources.scope: Priority policy edition 4, effective throughout Day 21
curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: A valid amber stamp is sufficient for priority-lane qualification. No weight check or supervisor signature is required for a parcel with that stamp.
The parcel bears a valid amber stamp.

curated_evidence_sources.scope: Edition 3, expired at the end of Day 20
curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: Amber stamps do not confer priority-lane qualification.

curated_evidence_sources.scope: Edition 5, scheduled to start on Day 22
curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: An amber stamp must be accompanied by a supervisor signature for priority-lane qualification.

rationale: The edition applicable at the claimed time makes the documented stamp sufficient. The earlier and later editions are outside that time.
discriminating_fact: The operative policy uses a sufficient condition that the parcel meets.

state.hypothesis_to_verify: Wendalis has completed all prerequisites for receiving a green studio key today.

curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: Receiving a green studio key requires both a passed safety briefing and a paid deposit. Both must be completed before the key can be issued.

curated_evidence_sources.scope: Wendalis's record at today's key decision
curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: Safety briefing: passed. Deposit: unpaid; no payment has been received.

rationale: The applicable policy requires payment, and the current record explicitly states that the deposit is unpaid.
discriminating_fact: A mandatory condition is explicitly false, rather than merely unmentioned.

state.hypothesis_to_verify: The completed Dravessa equipment case contains a copper calibration disk.

curated_evidence_sources.scope: Final inventory of the sealed Dravessa equipment case
curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: The following is the complete and exhaustive list of objects inside the case after packing: one glass prism, two ceramic spacers, and one linen cloth. No other objects are inside.

rationale: The inventory is explicitly exhaustive and excludes any objects beyond its listed contents, none of which is a copper calibration disk.
discriminating_fact: The source closes the inventory with 'No other objects are inside.'

state.hypothesis_to_verify: Orpelun's cart is eligible to cross the north bridge at noon today.

curated_evidence_sources.scope: North bridge eligibility rule for today
curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: A cart may be eligible to cross the north bridge only if it has a working brake. Having a working brake alone does not establish eligibility.

curated_evidence_sources.scope: Orpelun cart inspection at noon today
curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: The cart's only brake is broken and does not work. The cart has no alternative braking mechanism.

rationale: Eligibility implies a working brake, and the inspection explicitly establishes the absence of a working brake at the claimed time.
discriminating_fact: Failure of a necessary condition rules out eligibility.

state.hypothesis_to_verify: At noon on Day 8, a silver token is accepted for entry to the Halqerin observatory.

curated_evidence_sources.scope: Entry policy edition 1, effective Days 1 through 7
curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: Silver tokens are accepted for observatory entry.

curated_evidence_sources.scope: Entry policy edition 2, effective for all of Days 8 through 10
curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: Silver tokens are not accepted for observatory entry. This edition replaces edition 1 for its effective period.

curated_evidence_sources.scope: Entry policy edition 3, effective starting Day 11
curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: Silver tokens are accepted for observatory entry.

rationale: Only edition 2 applies at noon on Day 8, and it explicitly says silver tokens are not accepted.
discriminating_fact: The acceptance statements apply before and after, but not during, the claimed period.

state.hypothesis_to_verify: The Fenquara field kit contains every item required for a complete survey kit.

curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: A complete survey kit must contain a measuring cord, a sighting frame, and a brass marker.

curated_evidence_sources.scope: Excerpt from Fenquara field-kit packing record
curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: This excerpt reproduces only the first two lines of a longer contents list: measuring cord; sighting frame. The remaining lines are not included in this excerpt.

rationale: The excerpt establishes two required items but neither establishes nor excludes the brass marker because the contents list continues outside the excerpt.
discriminating_fact: The inventory is explicitly partial, so its omission cannot establish that the required marker is absent.

state.hypothesis_to_verify: Jaskovel is approved to supervise the east workshop today.

curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: A person can be approved to supervise the east workshop only if their induction is complete. This clause states a prerequisite; it does not specify all approval criteria or record individual approvals.
Induction status: complete.

rationale: Completion satisfies a necessary condition but does not establish approval, and no source states that approval was granted or denied.
discriminating_fact: The implication runs from approval to induction completion, not from completion to approval.

state.hypothesis_to_verify: Under today's rules, Myrtasen must wear a white wristband to enter the rehearsal room.

curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: All and only temporary performers must wear a white wristband to enter the rehearsal room. Permanent performers may enter without one.
Myrtasen is booked as a performer. The temporary-or-permanent classification field is blank, and this record does not supply that classification elsewhere.

rationale: The rules distinguish two performer classes with different wristband obligations, but the evidence does not identify Myrtasen's class.
discriminating_fact: The fact needed to choose the applicable rule is unavailable.

state.hypothesis_to_verify: At 15:00 today, the Drelvona water sample meets both conditions for release.

curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: A sample meets the conditions for release if and only if its seal is intact and its temperature at the time of release is below 8 degrees.
The seal is intact. Temperature was not measured during this inspection.
Temperature: 6 degrees. Storage conditions after this measurement are not recorded.

rationale: The seal condition is established at 15:00, but the earlier temperature does not establish the temperature at release. No source establishes that the later temperature meets or fails the threshold.
discriminating_fact: The essential temperature condition is unresolved at the specific claimed time.

state.hypothesis_to_verify: The Amsorin vault door was locked at precisely 18:00 on Day 4.

curated_evidence_sources.scope: Official inspection register A, Day 4 at precisely 18:00
curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: Amsorin vault door: locked. This is the current certified reading for that instant.

curated_evidence_sources.scope: Official inspection register B, Day 4 at precisely 18:00
curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: Amsorin vault door: unlocked. This is the current certified reading for that instant.
Registers A and B have equal authority. Neither reading has been corrected or withdrawn, and no priority rule selects one register over the other.

rationale: Equal-authority current records assert opposite door states at the exact same instant, with no correction or priority rule resolving them.
discriminating_fact: The incompatibility concerns one door at one instant, not different observation times.

state.hypothesis_to_verify: The current Velcrane exhibit-entry policy requires a printed program from every adult visitor.

curated_evidence_sources.scope: Current authorized exhibit-entry policy copy A, edition 6
curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: Every adult visitor must present a printed program as a condition of entry.

curated_evidence_sources.scope: Current authorized exhibit-entry policy copy B, edition 6
curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: A printed program is optional for every adult visitor and is not a condition of entry.
Both copies are authorized for the same exhibit and dates. Neither supersedes the other; both retain equal policy authority and no controlling copy is designated.

rationale: The equally authoritative operative copies make the same item mandatory and optional for the same population and period.
discriminating_fact: The optionality statement is applicable to exactly the visitors covered by the mandatory statement.

state.hypothesis_to_verify: Every member of the Pellunex evening cohort attended the Day 9 drill.

curated_evidence_sources.scope: Final Day 9 drill report for Pellunex evening cohort
curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: All 12 members of the evening cohort attended the drill, including member E7.

curated_evidence_sources.scope: Final Day 9 drill attendance register for Pellunex evening cohort
curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: E7 was a member of the evening cohort on Day 9. E7 did not attend any portion of the Day 9 drill.
The final report and final register have equal authority. Both remain current; neither has a correction, and there is no rule preferring one.

rationale: One current record explicitly includes E7 among all attendees, while another current record explicitly excludes E7 from attendance in the same cohort and drill.
discriminating_fact: The named nonattendee is expressly within the same claimed cohort and event.

state.hypothesis_to_verify: As of the final review at 16:00 on Day 17, Quervessa's package meets all conditions for dispatch.

curated_evidence_sources.scope: Dispatch conditions at the Day 17 final review
curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: A package meets all dispatch conditions if and only if it has both a readable address and a signed release.

curated_evidence_sources.scope: Current final-review record A, Quervessa package, Day 17 at 16:00
curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: The address is readable and the release is signed.

curated_evidence_sources.scope: Current final-review record B, Quervessa package, Day 17 at 16:00
curated_evidence_sources.excerpt: The address is readable and the release is unsigned.
Records A and B describe the same release document at the same review instant. They have equal authority, neither supersedes the other, and no corrected record has been issued.

rationale: The address condition is consistent, but equally authoritative records disagree on whether the same release is signed at the claimed instant, producing both support and refutation of the compound claim.
discriminating_fact: A required component has explicit incompatible values in equally current same-scope records.
